the geology of the ocean floor.

your steed.

yogurt. Use it during a chocobo race

your steed.

2391.name: Shadow Apple
desc:
A ripe faerie apple dipped in aromatic
coffee. Use it during a chocobo race

your steed.

desc:
A biscuit laced with a ridiculous
amount of black pepper, guaranteed to
cause anyone who consumes it to have
a sneezing fit.

When used during a chocobo race...

2393.name: Fire Biscuit
desc:
A biscuit laced with a ridiculous
number of hot peppers, guaranteed to
set on fire the mouth of anyone who
consumes it.

When used during a chocobo race...

2394.name: Gysahl Bomb
desc:
A prank firework that emits a thick
gas smelling remarkably similar to
gysahl greens.

When used during a chocobo race...

A prank firework that releases a
thick gas containing the spores of
danceshrooms.

When used during a chocobo race...

fair weather.

to implore the spirits of nature for
rain.

When offered during a chocobo race...

for optimum muscle management.

increases a chocobo's strength.

desc:

allowing the bird to concentrate
on the track ahead.

When equipped during a race,
increases a chocobo's endurance.

2400.name: Shadow Roll
desc:
Blocks a chocobo's view of the ground
directly below it, allowing the bird to
concentrate on the track ahead.

When equipped during a race,
increases a chocobo's discernment.

2401.name: Chocobo Hood
desc:
Covers a chocobo's ears, thus blocking
out surrounding noise and allowing the
bird to concentrate on the track.

When equipped during a race,
increases a chocobo's receptivity.

chocobo in a CRA-sanctioned race.

selecting the order in which chocobos
will place in races. Winning tickets
should be taken to the nearest CRA
outlet.

2480.name: Gauger Plate
desc: The fearsome image of a fiend's soul has been burned on this plate with a Soulgauger SGR-1.

2481.name: Comp. Certificate
desc:
A document distributed certifying
the participation of your chocobo
in a CRA-sanctioned race. Necessary
for collecting any reward money.

2482.name: Chocotrain: STR
desc:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo strength conditioning.

2483.name: Chocotrain: END
desc:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo endurance conditioning.

2484.name: Chocotrain: DSC
desc:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo discernment conditioning.

2485.name: Chocotrain: RCP
desc:
This VCS-issued token can be
exchanged for 1 (one) session of
chocobo receptivity conditioning.

2486.name: Chocobuck Slip
desc:
Exchange this ticket for chocobucks at
any VCS Chocobuck Exchange Depot.

2487.name: M. Camp Entry
desc:
A form permitting entry to a top-
secret mercenary training camp.
The Salaheem's Sentinels logo
can be seen when held to a light.

2488.name: Alexandrite
desc:
A rare and precious gem, the color of
which shifts between various hues of
green and red depending on the light.

2489.name: W. Areuhat
desc:
A full-color transcription of the
famous Near Eastern literary classic.
Tells the story of a bold young
swordswoman and her adventures while
seeking out the wyrms of Vana'diel.

2490.name: Forbidden Key
desc: A key from a forgotten time, plucked from a dark chasm of time and space.

2491.name: Leujaoam Log
desc:
A blank Assault log given to you by
Paparoon. It contains enough room for
even the most ambitious of Leujaoam
Sanctum exploits to be committed to
page in scrupulous detail.

2492.name: Mamool Ja Journal
desc:
A blank Assault journal given to you
by Paparoon. It contains enough room
for even the most ambitious of Mamool
Ja Training Grounds exploits to be
committed to page in scrupulous detail.

2493.name: Lebros Chronicle
desc:
A blank Assault chronicle given to you
by Paparoon. It contains enough room
for even the most ambitious of Lebros
Cavern exploits to be committed to
page in scrupulous detail.

2494.name: Periqia Diary
desc:
A blank Assault diary given to you by
Paparoon. It contains enough room for
even the most ambitious of Periqia
exploits to be committed to page in
scrupulous detail.

2495.name: Ilrusi Ledger
desc:
A blank Assault ledger given to you by
Paparoon. It contains enough room for
even the most ambitious of Ilrusi Atoll
exploits to be committed to page in
scrupulous detail.

2496.name: Anc. Beast Horn
desc: The gnarled horn of a prehistoric beast, long since extinct.

2497.name: Kukulkan's Skin
desc: The exceptionally pliant and durable skin of Kukulkan. Ideal as a shock-absorbent lining for armor.

2498.name: Briareus's Sash
desc: A prized possession of the legendary Gigas, Briareus, unable to be severed by even the sharpest blade.

2499.name: Regurg. Wing
desc: This partially digested wing retrieved from a glavoid clearly did not agree with the giant worm's stomach.

2500.name: Official Reflector
desc:
This soul reflector has been approved
for use in all Pankration events. The
outline of a monster has been branded
onto the back of the reflector.

2501.name: B. Puppet Turban
desc:
This turban is for use on
Stormwaker-type automatons.
Enhances black magic skills.

2502.name: W. Puppet Turban
desc:
This turban is for use on
Stormwaker-type automatons.
Enhances white magic skills.

2503.name: Almond
desc:
Seeds of the almond tree
found in the Near East.

2504.name: H. Qdv. Chestplate
desc:
A durable chestplate worn by the
Quadav during battle. It is far too
bulky for people to wear.

2505.name: H. Qdv. Backplate
desc:
A durable shell worn by the Quadav
during battle. It is far too heavy for
people to wear.

2506.name: Ladybug Wing
desc:
This hard, shell-like wing bears
a unique red and black pattern.

2507.name: Lycopodium Flower
desc:
This bright red flower has been plucked
from the head of a lycopodium.

2508.name: Gold Dust
desc: 99.9% pure.

2509.name: Slug Eye
desc:
The remarkably elastic
eye stalk of a slug.

2510.name: Orc Helmet
desc:
A Goblin-made helmet worn by Orcs.
It is far too bulky for people to wear.

2511.name: Orc Pauldron
desc:
A Goblin-made shoulderpiece from
the armor of an Orc. It is far too
heavy for people to wear.

2512.name: Lynx Hide
desc: The colorful hide of a lynx.

2513.name: Rafflesia Vine
desc:
A vine cut from a carnivorous rafflesia.
The poisonous thorns aid the plant in
capturing prey.

2514.name: Rafflesia Petal
desc:
The fleshy petal of a carnivorous
rafflesia. The hook at its tip is used
to render prey immobile.

2515.name: Sandworm Fang
desc:
A serrated tooth taken from the maw
of a sandworm.

2516.name: Sandworm Shell
desc:
A chitinous plate that protects the
body of a sandworm.

2517.name: FES Gobbie Key
desc: This slightly rusted key, found in a locked chest on a long-sunken ship, can be used to open the special dial of the Goblin mystery box.

2518.name: Smilodon Hide
desc: The striped hide of a smilodon.

2519.name: Yagudo Osode
desc:
A pauldron worn by the Yagudo. Its
awkward design makes it impossible for
people to wear.

2520.name: Yagudo Kote
desc:
A gauntlet worn by the Yagudo. Its
awkward design makes it impossible
for people to wear.

2521.name: Gnole Claw
desc:
The feculent claw of a gnole.
These talons are said to harbor
a score of infectious diseases.

2522.name: Gnat Wing
desc:
The light, yet pliable wing of
a giant gnat.

2523.name: Peiste Skin
desc: The elastic skin of a peiste.

2524.name: Peiste Stinger
desc:
A poisonous stinger found on the
head of a peiste.

2525.name: Bottled Pixie
desc:
Did you remember to
put holes in the lid?

2526.name: Bkn. MMM Rod
desc: Clearly of questionable durability from the start, this Moblin Maze Mongers fishing rod is now broken and unusable.

2527.name: Red Oven Mitt
desc:
Protects little Hume hands from hot
pots and pans.

2528.name: Plume d'Or
desc:
An attractive brooch comprised of
a gold feather and a single pearl.

2529.name: Smildn. Leather
desc: Hardy smilodon leather.

2530.name: Lynx Leather
desc: Light and durable lynx leather.

2531.name: Obsidian
desc:
This shiny, black volcanic glass
is often used in making weapons.

2532.name: Teak Log
desc: A rough-cut log of teak timber.

2533.name: Teak Lumber
desc: Processed teak lumber.

2534.name: Jacaranda Log
desc: A rough-cut log of jacaranda timber.

2535.name: Jacaranda Lbr.
desc: Processed jacaranda lumber.

2536.name: Electrum Ingot
desc: An ingot of smelted electrum.

2537.name: Cilice
desc:
Cloth woven from
wool and dhalmel hair.

2538.name: Peiste Leather
desc: Rough yet beautiful peiste leather.

2539.name: Dhalmel Hair
desc: The shiny, silken hair of a dhalmel.

2540.name: Magellan Card
desc:
A card created by the moogles for
the Starlight Celebration. When
opened, you can see twinkling stars.

2541.name: Andromeda Card
desc:
A card created by the moogles for
the Starlight Celebration. When
opened, you can see twinkling stars.

2542.name: Goblin Mess Tin
desc:
An all-purpose trencher forged from
darksteel. 7 out of 10 Goblins don't
leave home without one.

2543.name: Goblin Weel
desc:
A willow wicker basket used by
Goblins to catch fish and eels.

2544.name: Smilodon Collar
desc:
An large, leather collar studded with
sharp spikes.

2545.name: Lynx Collar
desc: A heavy collar made of gold.

2546.name: Blk. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of black bolts.

2547.name: Obsid. Arrowhd.
desc: The striking tips of obsidian arrows.

2548.name: Gnat Fletchings
desc:
Gnat wings that are fitted to the nock
end of arrow shafts. They add to the
directional stability of arrows in flight.

2549.name: Djinn Ash
desc: The burnt remains of a djinn.

2550.name: Vellum
desc:
High-quality parchment made from
sheepskin. This particular piece
features a decorative border.

2551.name: Electrum Chain
desc: This chain is made of electrum links.

2552.name: Campaign Voucher
desc: A form of Op Credit endowing the holder with the right to participate in Campaign Ops. Issued by the Allied Forces high command.

2553.name: Sanjaku-Tenugui
desc:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Monomi."

2554.name: Asphodel
desc:
Known for its pungent aroma, this
yellow flower is known throughout
San d'Oria as the "Undying Lily."

2555.name: Soshi
desc:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Aisha."

2556.name: Dnc. Testimony
desc:
This papyrus scroll reads:
"The bearer of this document has
 proven excellence in the ways of
 the dancer."

2557.name: Sch. Testimony
desc:
This papyrus scroll reads:
"The bearer of this document has
 proven excellence in the ways of
 the scholar."

2558.name: Yagudo Glue
desc: A fine grained glue mixed by the Yagudo, used in the repair of pottery.

2559.name: Bonanza Marble
desc: A Mog Bonanza marble inscribed with the numbers which you have selected. Issued by the Mog House Management Union.
